title: Confidence-Modulated Safety Filtering for End-to-End Policies
description:
arXiv:2610.40922v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: End-to-end policies, from task-specific controllers to robot foundation models, learn complex behavior from raw observations but are not guaranteed to remain safe, so they are often wrapped in a safety filter. The resulting system operates under two domains: the filter's operational design domain (ODD), where its assumptions hold and safety is certified, and the policy's competence domain, where it is reliable.
